title: Move Your Hips, Not Your Drama: Sacral Chakra Yoga For Gay Men
description: Hip-opening yoga for gay men ready to breathe, soften, and stop clenching through the plot twist.
long_description:
Hip-opening yoga for gay men ready to breathe, soften, and stop clenching through the plot twist.

About this Event

Welcome to a Sacral Chakra yoga class for gay men who are ready to move their hips, soften their bodies, and stop treating pleasure like a suspicious email attachment.
This class focuses on the Sacral Chakra, also known as Svadhisthana, the energetic center connected to emotion, creativity, sensuality, pleasure, and flow. This center is described as the seat of human emotion below the navel and associated with the Water element, flow, sensuality, and creativity. 
Expect a queer-centered, welcoming, body-positive yoga experience built around hip mobility, spinal movement, breath, and gentle release. 

This is not about forcing flexibility, performing sensuality, or pretending your hips are not storing three situationships and a Venmo request. It is about creating space for movement, breath, emotional flow, and embodied joy.
Come as you are. Leave feeling softer, freer, more connected, and maybe slightly less clenched by life’s nonsense
